scope: Artificial identities, in-memory consumption, intent-only adapter; test-only channel validates current identity atomically before setting an artificial event
deadline_policy: Execution deadline armed at reservation; cleanup ends at earlier of execution deadline plus cleanup budget or stop-intent time plus cleanup budget; equality expires
terminal_policy: No terminal promotion, restart, retry or reservation/command reuse within the same reservation book
delivery_gate_policy: Any invalid, expired or rollback consumption permanently quarantines that gate; fresh caller timestamps cannot reopen it
limits: No native interruption or operating-system identity/exit proof
Artificial receipts are not authenticated live evidence
Caller must schedule tick; controller_lost is a supplied artificial observation, not death detection
next_gate: Review the isolated adapter and unresolved operational scope before separately authorizing any live control test or service deployment
